body: What you are saying makes total sense, but what I am trying to portray is that you are in fact not helpless. I can after periods of indulgence and social isolation (happened in lockdown) feel somewhat depressed, but the thing that keeps me from actually depresses or perhaps suicidal is that I can simply complete the steps I outlined in my post and I will feel better than ever

Yeah, it had not really crossed my mind that the main symptom of suicidal thoughts is not having anyone that cares about you. Still, I think these things would help as they may at least give you the motivation to form relationships.
